findings.evidence: Lines 50–59 assume only `AddCommGroup`; lines 112–154 call arbitrary additive groups and maps “lattices” and “lattice maps.” The roadmap README lines 86–89 defines an integral lattice as finite free, and `Suggested.lean:30` scopes this layer under `[Module.Free ℤ N] [Module.Finite ℤ N]`; the existing `IsIntegralLattice` at `Algebraic/Lattice.lean:73–78` explicitly stores those properties.
findings.fix: Require the established lattice hypotheses (`Module.Free ℤ N` and `Module.Finite ℤ N`, with the relevant module structure) throughout this API, or parameterize it by the existing integral-lattice data; apply the same restriction to `N'`, `N''`, and `complexTorusMap`.
findings.issue: All declarations accept an arbitrary `AddCommGroup N`, although the canonical toric object requires `N` to be finite free over `ℤ`; for torsion or infinite-rank inputs, `ComplexTorus N` need not be a finite-dimensional complex torus. For example, with `N = ZMod 2`, `N →+ ℤ` is trivial, so the alleged torus is a singleton.

summary: The API does not enforce the roadmap’s finite-free integral-lattice prerequisite, so `ComplexTorus` denotes non-tori for admitted inputs.
